responsibility: Defines rustc's target ABI data model and type-layout interface, exposing layout/index wrapper types, `TyAndLayout` traversal helpers, and the `TyAbiInterface` contract that higher compiler layers implement so calling convention code can inspect and classify Rust types.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/mod.rs`, which builds on ABI data to lower function signatures, and unlike the `spec`/`asm` `mod.rs` files, this `mod.rs` defines the crate's core target ABI and layout model—layout wrappers, field/variant indices, and the `TyAbiInterface` used by call-lowering code.
